cards.name: Dragonstone Proselyte
cards.text: Challenges Action: Kneel Dragonstone Proselyte to choose a character with STR 3 or lower. Until the end of the round, that character cannot stand.
cards.flavor: "He has an ally. R'hllor, the Lord of Light, the Heart of Fire, the God of Flame and Shadow." - Selyse Baratheon

cards.name: Fiery Talons
cards.text: Action: Kneel a R'hllor character to choose a participating character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets -1 STR and is placed in shadows if its STR is 0.
cards.flavor: ...and high, high in the eastern sky, against the wall of cloud, Jon saw the eagle burning.

cards.name: Priest on the Docks
cards.text: Reaction: After you win dominance, kill Priest on the Docks to choose a non-limited location or attachment with printed cost 3 or lower and discard it from play.
cards.flavor: The priest was garbed in mottled robes of green and grey and blue, the swirling colors of the Drowned God.

cards.name: Deepwood Motte
cards.text: Reaction: After a location is knelt by assault during a challenge in which you are the attacking player, kneel Deepwood Motte to choose and stand a Raider character you control or Asha Greyjoy. -2 Initiative.

cards.name: King's Landing Septon
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of an opponent's triggered character, location, or attachment ability would initiate, return King's Landing Septon to your hand to cancel those effects.
cards.flavor: "All King's Landing shall pray for your success." - The High Septon

cards.name: Hornvale
cards.text: Reaction: After you win an [intrigue] challenge, kneel Hornvale to have the losing opponent choose a card in their hand and place it facedown under Hornvale. If Hornvale leaves play, return each card under it to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Shadow City Septon
cards.text: Shadow (3). Reaction: After you lose dominance, return Shadow City Septon to shadows to have the winning opponent choose a standing character they control. Return that character to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: ...the Old Palace and its shadow city were full of eyes.

cards.name: A Game of Cyvasse
cards.text: Challenges Action: Each player cannot declare more than 1 character as an attacker or defender in the next [intrigue] challenge you initiate this phase. If you win that challenge, you may initiate an additional [intrigue] challenge this phase. (Max 1 per phase.)

cards.name: Superstitious Steward
cards.text: Reaction: After a phase begins, name a Trait. If an opponent reveals a plot card with that Trait during this phase, you may sacrifice Superstitious Steward to have that player choose a character they control and discard it from play.
cards.flavor: "The Seven have never answered my prayers. Perhaps the old gods will." - Samwell Tarly

cards.name: For All the Nights to Come
cards.text: Reaction: After you win a challenge by 5 or more STR, choose a Builder character, a Ranger character, and a Steward character. Each of those characters gains 1 power. (Max 1 per phase.)

cards.name: Woods Witch
cards.text: Reaction: After a character is discarded from an opponent's hand, sacrifice Woods Witch to name a cardtype. That player must sacrifice a card with that cardtype and the same printed cost as the discarded card.
cards.flavor: "They know a little herb-craft and some midwifery, but elsewise..." - Cersei Lannister

cards.name: Grey Cliffs
cards.text: Interrupt: When Grey Cliffs is sacrificed, draw 1 card. +1 Initiative.

cards.name: Purple Graces
cards.text: Action: During a [military] challenge, kneel Purple Graces to choose an attacking character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets -2 STR.
cards.flavor: "I shall pray and make sacrifice. Mayhaps the gods of Ghis will hear me." - Galazza Galare

cards.name: By Sword or By Guile
cards.text: Interrupt: When claim is applied for a [military] or [intrigue] challenge in which you control an attacking Army or Dragon character, apply [power] claim instead.
cards.flavor: "If Storm's End is so impregnable, how do you mean to take it?" - Malo

cards.name: Starry Septa
cards.text: Action: Kneel Starry Septa to choose a participating character with gold or power. Stand that character and remove it from the challenge.
cards.flavor: "...it grieves me to say that the young queen and her ladies cannot be released until and unless their innocence has been proved." - Septa Moelle

cards.name: Horn Hill
cards.text:
During the first challenge you initiate each phase, raise the claim value on your revealed plot card by 1.
+1 Initiative.

cards.name: Theodan the True
cards.text: No attachments except The Seven. Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Theodan the True is participating, choose a The Seven character. Until the end of the phase, that character gains insight or renown. (Limit twice per phase.)

cards.name: The Riverroad
cards.text: Limited. Action: Kneel and sacrifice The Riverroad to choose a character. Until the end of the phase, that character gains a challenge icon of your choice. +1 Income.

cards.name: Kingswood Ambush
cards.text:
You cannot marshal characters.
Reduce the cost to ambush each of your cards by 2.

cards.name: Sentinels of the Realm
cards.text: You may include non-loyal Guard characters from any faction in your deck. You must include at least 12 Guard characters in your deck. While you control no Guard characters, you cannot play events. Interrupt: When the challenges phase ends, draw 1 card for each challenge type that has not been initiated against you this phase.
